messages:
sam: FYI link-check failed on CI for /docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md - image at /assets/diagrams/kv-cache.png 404 in staging build. Anyone owning runtime-guide?
ci-bot: build/links · job 42 failed 
failed checks:
- link-check: broken asset /assets/diagrams/kv-cache.png -> 404
see: https://ci.internal/redwood/42/logs
lauren: i can take this. which env produced the 404? staging or prod?
sam: staging preview of #1723 (recent runtime edits). It looks like we removed the diagram file in a cleanup PR earlier.
ben: we moved diagrams to the CDN bucket last week; older markdown points to the repo path. Quick fix: either rehost to cdn.redwoodassets.com/diagrams/kv-cache.png or add a redirect in doclinks.yaml from the old path.
lauren: i'll do the CDN rehost in the PR to reduce future 404 risk. Will upload file to S3 and update the image URL to https://cdn.redwoodassets.com/diagrams/kv-cache.png.
docs-bot: tip: run `npm run docs:link-check` locally before pushing; saves a CI cycle.
anya: small ask: please add `owner: "eng-runtime"` in the frontmatter for runtime-guide so we have clear ownership.
lauren: yep will add frontmatter and a one-line changelog entry. Branch name: docs/fix/runtime-diagram-404
lauren: PR created https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1150 - replaces image link, uploads diagram to CDN, adds frontmatter owner and changelog.
ci-bot: build/links · job 45 queued
ci-bot: build/links · job 45 passed 
ci-bot: all checks green for PR 1150
ben: nice. can you also add a shortlink redirect in doclinks.yaml so any external refs to the old repo path still work? small two-line entry.
lauren: added doclinks redirect on the PR, plus `owner: eng-runtime`. Squashed commits.
sam: tagging @ben for a quick review of the CDN url; he knows the S3 bucket perms.
ben: checked the S3 ACLs; file is public-read and cache-control set. LGTM.
anya: approved for owner/frontmatter.
lauren: merging now. I'll flip the staging preview once it lands. :shipit:
sam: thanks! saved us a customer-facing blip.
